ro.param.output_path.description: Destination path relative to the current workdir. Absolute paths must still be inside the workdir.
ro.param.overwrite.description: Overwrite the destination if it already exists (default: false).
ro.error.destination_exists: destination already exists; set overwrite to true to replace it
ro.error.destination_directory: output_path must name a file, not a directory
ro.error.invalid_output_path: output_path must be inside the workdir
ro.param.artifact_id.description: ID-ul artefactului sau referința artifact:// dintr-un rezultat anterior al unui instrument.
ro.error.invalid_artifact_id: artifact_id trebuie să fie un ID de artefact valid sau o referință artifact://
